code='''def transform(grid):
    # Read color markers at intersections of full separator rows and columns.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    # infer regularly spaced separator lines; output one value per intervening tile,
    # taking the marker at each tile's upper-left crossing when present.
    if len(rows)<2 or len(cols)<2: return [[grid[0][0]]]
    out=[]
    for ri in range(len(rows)-1):
        row=[]
        for ci in range(len(cols)-1):
            row.append(grid[rows[ri]][cols[ci]])
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
